name: CodeYam Editor
postCreateCommand: sh .devcontainer/codeyam-system-deps.sh && npm install -g @codeyam-editor/codeyam-editor@latest @anthropic-ai/claude-code && npx -y playwright install --with-deps chromium && sh .devcontainer/project-setup.sh
postStartCommand: sh .devcontainer/codeyam-system-deps.sh; deps=$?; sh .devcontainer/project-setup.sh || echo 'Project setup failed; see the output above.'; mkdir -p .codeyam/logs && setsid -f nohup sh .devcontainer/codeyam-start.sh postStart "$deps" >> .codeyam/logs/codespaces-editor.log 2>&1 < /dev/null
